question.text: Which of the following strategies is NOT typically implemented by a Category III AIF under Chapter 10?

explanation.text: The Logic: Buyout (LBO) PE is Cat I/II territory (specifically Cat II PE funds). Cat III runs listed-market strategies (long-short, macro, arb, event-driven, market-neutral). Chapter 10 does NOT list buyout as a Cat III strategy. The Trap: All of A, C, D are explicitly named in Chapter 10 Sections 10.1.1-10.1.4. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-D (Cat I/II) covers buyout. XIX-E EXCLUDES it as primary content. Manager's Pro-Tip: If an investor asks 'can your Cat III do LBO?' — answer no: Cat III is daily-NAV liquid markets; LBO requires 5-10 year lock-in and comes through Cat II closed-ended structure. Route such inquiries to the Cat II vehicle or affiliated Cat II manager.
